Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase. The players have made their way out to the middle. Jason Roy and Philip Salt will open the batting for England. Logan van Beek will begin the proceedings with the ball. Let's go!
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Right then! England will be sensing another victory here! But we cannot count Netherlands out of this one just yet. An intriguing chase coming up. Can Netherlands defend this one? We will find out. Stay tuned for the second essay.

After electing to bat first, the Dutch were put under immense pressure early on. They lost top-order within a blink of an eye. But post that, the stand-in skipper, Scott Edwards and Bas de Leede put together 61 runs and did some damage repair. Bas de Leede perished after a fine start. Teja Nidamanuru walked in with some positive intent and Netherlands put up another good stand then. A much more aggressive one this time. However, Teja Nidamanuru also departed and failed to convert his start. Scott Edwards led from the front and scored a sublime 78. Logan van Beek and Shane Snater then played a few lusty blows in the end and guided Netherlands over the 230-mark. They might feel they feel short of around 30 runs here. It's onto the bowlers now. Netherlands will need something special to defend this target.

The visitors had the perfect start with the ball. They grabbed three wickets in quick succession and put Netherlands under the pump straightaway. They dominated the first Powerplay of the innings but lost their way a bit in the middle. They did not leak as many runs but failed to capitalize on the start they had got. A couple of partnerships in the middle phase swung the momentum towards Netherlands only for a bit. England made sure they came back stronger and took the wickets at the right time and did not let the game slip away from them. David Willey and Adil Rashid grabbed two wickets each, while Liam Livingstone and Brydon Carse took a wicket apiece. England have an opportunity here to seal the series.

End of an entertaining first half of the game! England will be the happier side of the two going into this break. A good finish though for Netherlands. They scored 43 runs in the last 4 overs and have put a respectable total on the board. Still, a tough task for them, considering the dangerous batting lineup England possesses.

SIX! Take that, says Logan van Beek! Willey bowls it right in the slot on off. Logan van Beek gets under it and tonks it over long on to finish the innnings on a high. Netherlands finish with 235/7 after 41 overs!
Back of a length, on off. Snater swings hard but gets only a single to long on.
Short and wide, outside off. Snater cuts it aerially and the ball falls in the vacant deep point region. Two runs added to the total.
On a length, on middle. Logan van Beek works it to square leg for a single.
On a length, outside off. Logan van Beek throws his bat at it but misses.

Just away from Morgan! Short and wide, outside off. It is slower in pace and Logan van Beek mistimes his slash. It goes aerially towards extra-cover but just away from Morgan running back. Two runs taken.
A fullish delivery on middle and leg. Logan van Beek tries to heave it towards the leg side but misses. The ball rolls onto the turf off his pads and the batters steal a leg bye.
Another slower delivery, on a length, on off. Logan van Beek pushes it through covers for a couple.
WIDE! Tries an off-pace short delivery but sprays it down the leg side. Logan van Beek looks to pull but misses.
A fullish delivery on off. Snater backs away and swings it hard towards long on for a single.
A shorter-length delivery angling into middle. Logan van Beek pulls it to deep backward square leg for a single.
Dot ball again! On a length and angling into middle and leg. Logan van Beek looks to work it towards the leg side but misses. He is hit high on his pads.
On a length, outside off. Logan van Beek swings across the line but misses.
Brydon Carse (6-0-31-1) is back on!
Pushed quicker on off. Logan van Beek drives it to long off for a single.

Good running! Tossed up on middle. Logan van Beek works it to deep mid-wicket and the batters run back for the secoond run. Dawid Malan has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. Shane Snater would have been in trouble if that would have hit.
A flatter one, around off. Snater punches it towards backward point for a single.
Tossed up on middle. Shane Snater looks to go big again but mistimes it towards deep mid-wicket for a couple.
A flatter one around off. Logan van Beek pushes it through covers for a single.
SIX! Here he goes, Logan van Beek! Tossed up on off. Logan van Beek dances down the track and launches it over long on for a biggie.

SIX! BOOM! Netherlands are going to need a few more of these! A length ball, around middle and leg. Shane Snater shimmies down the track and heaves it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie. 200 up for Netherlands with that!
Lands on a length, outside off. Shane Snater comes down the track and swings across the line but misses.
Bangs it short on middle. Logan van Beek mistimes his pull to square leg for a single.
Drifting on the pads this time. Logan van Beek flicks it to deep square leg for a couple.
A fuller delivery on off. Shane Snater pushes it to long on for a single.
Angling into middle this time. Shane Snater works it towards deep backward square leg for a couple.
Another sweep and another miss! It is around off and turns back in. Logan van Beek looks to sweep and gets hit on his body as he misses it yet again.
Flatter and outside off. Logan van Beek goes for the sweep shot but misses. He gets rapped up on the pads. However, the impact is outside off here as the appeal is turned down.
Fuller on middle. Shane Snater sweeps it to short fine leg for a single.
Shane Snater comes to the crease.

OUT! KNOCKED HIM OVER! Too good for Tim Pringle on his debut! Rashid tosses it up on off and it is a googly this time. Tim Pringle tries to work it towards the leg side but misses as the ball sneaks through between his bat and pad. The ball knocks over the stumps and Netherlands lose their seventh now.
Loopy delivery on off. Logan van Beek sweeps it to fine leg for a single this time.
Tossed up on off. Logan van Beek reverse-sweeps it to short third man.
He lands it on a length again, on off. Tim Pringle defends it solidly.
Back of a length and angling into middle. Logan van Beek tucks it wide of square leg for a single.
Tad shorter, angling in, around the leg pole. Logan van Beek misses his flick and gets hit on his pads.
Fuller, around middle and off. Logan van Beek pushes it back to the bowler.
Back of a length, outside off. Logan van Beek tries to have a poke at it but he misses once again. Logan van Beek has just not been able to get going here.
On a length, on off. Logan van Beek blocks it out.
Tim Pringle walks in next. He is on debut! Reece Topley is also back into the attack now.

OUT! RUN OUT! Bullseye! An excellent innings comes to an end! This is not the way he would have liked to go back though. A shorter, around middle. Scott Edwards flicks it towards mid-wicket. They run the first one fast and come back for the second one. David Willey runs from the deep, collects the ball from his left hand and scores a direct hit at the striker's end. Scott Edwards puts in a dive but he falls just short of his ground. He walks back to a standing ovation!
Is that a run out? David Willey has fired a direct hit at the batter's end! Scott Edwards has put in a dive but replays show that he is short of the crease and Scott Edwards has to walk back.
A leg-break, full, slower through the air, around middle. Logan van Beek looks to flick this but the ball goes off the leading edge towards point for a single.
Fuller, slower through the air, around off. Logan van Beek looks to reverse-sweep this but he misses.
Loopy ball now, down the leg side, full in length. Scott Edwards taps it towards fine leg for a single.
Another ball spinning away, short again, around off. Logan van Beek works it away towards mid-wicket. Another single.
A leg-break, short in length, outside off. Scott Edwards slaps it towards deep point for a single.
Shorter ball, around middle and leg. Scott Edwards pulls it towards deep square leg for a single.

Leg bye! A length ball, angling in around the leg pole. Logan van Beek looks to flick but he misses and gets hit on his thigh pad. An appeal there for LBW, but turned down. The ball rolls towards point and the batters steal in a leg bye!
Beaten! Length ball, shaping away, outside off. Logan van Beek looks to have a poke at it but he gets beaten on the outside edge.
Shorter ball, around off. Scott Edwards pushes it towards cover-point for a single.
A length ball, darting it on the thigh pads. Scott Edwards works it away towards mid-wicket for a brace.
SIX! Oh, shot! Scott Edwards is playing to the field! A fuller ball, around middle and off. Scott Edwards reverse-scoops this over short third man for a biggie. Innovation at its best!
End of Powerplay2! It's time for Powerplay 3! Now, a maximum of 5 fielders can be placed outside the inner circle till the end of the innings.
Flatter, quicker, shorter around off. Logan van Beek blocks it out.
Tosses this one up, full in length, around off. Scott Edwards sweeps it towards deep square leg. Single taken!
A googly, around middle and leg, shorter ball. Logan van Beek flicks it towards square leg for a single.
A fuller ball, around the leg pole. Logan van Beek gets down on his knee and tries t sweep this but the ball goes his gloves towards short fine leg. A stifled appeal there for LBW, but turned down!
Sower through the air, outside off, slower again. Scott Edwards sweeps it towards deep square leg for a single.
Loopy ball, outside off, spinning away. Scott Edwards misses his sweep shot.
Adil Rashid is brought back into the attack now. He has bowled 5 overs for 27 runs so far and has picked one wicket.
Another dot to end the over! Tad slower, outside off, this one stays low as well. Logan van Beek hangs back and tries to block this but misses.
And again! Outside off, length delivery, swinging away. Logan van Beek gets beaten on the outside edge again.
Beaten! This one shapes away, outside off, on a length. Logan van Beek stays back and tries to block this but he gets beaten on the outside edge.
Much fuller on this occasion, around middle and off. Logan van Beek drives and finds the fielder at mid on.
Logan van Beek walks out to the middle now.

OUT! CLEANED HIM UP! David Willey strikes and gets his second wicket! He gets rid of a well-set Teja Nidamanuru. He was looking in fine touch. A length delivery, this one lands around off and nips back in. Teja Nidamanuru tries to push this down the ground but he misses. The ball goes in the big gap between bat and pad and shatters the stumps. Netherlands have lost half their side now.
Yorker-length delivery, around middle and off. Scott Edwards looks to slog this away but the ball goes off the inside edge back onto his pads and towards square leg. Single taken!
Length ball, tighter line, around the off pole. Scott Edwards steers it down to third man for a single.
Beaten again! On a length, outside off, tad slower. Scott Edwards looks to have a poke at it but he misses.
Swing and a miss! A length ball, outside off. Scott Edwards backs away and tries to drive this but he misses.
Wide! A fuller ball, down the leg side. Scott Edwards leaves it alone. Wide called!
Tad shorter, outside off. Teja Nidamanuru dabs it towards backward point and scampers across to the other end. Jason Roy scores a direct hit at the bowler's end but Teja Nidamanuru was well in.
On a length, around off. Scott Edwards taps it towards cover for a single.
FOUR! Crunched! This is much better from Netherlands! A short ball, around middle and off. Scott Edwards pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a boundary.

FOUR BYES! Jos Buttler's average day behind the stumps continues! This is a full toss, outside off and Teja Nidamanuru tries to drive it away. He misses and the ball goes off the bounce towards Buttler. He fails to get down in time and the ball sneaks through him for a boundary.
A fullish delivery on off. Edwards goes across a bit and pushes it to long on for a single.

Ohh...direct hit and Teja Nidamanuru was a goner! A full delivery on off. Teja Nidamanuru looks to heave it across the line. He, however, gets an inside edge onto his pads and the ball rolls behind square on the off side. The batters try to steal a single. Buttler runs across and has a shy at the bowler's end but he misses and a single is completed.
FOUR! This time he finds the gap and it will be a boundary. Short delivery on middle. Teja Nidamanuru picks the length quickly and pulls it towards the square leg fence for a boundary.
This is full and around off. Teja Nidamanuru clears his front leg and hits it hard but straight to mid off.
Willey starts the new spell with almost a yorker on middle. Teja Nidamanuru digs it out.

Slight halt! Teja Nidamanuru seems to have hurt his hand while attempting a pull shot. The physio is out there in the middle with him. A couple of painkillers for him and he is good to go! Also, David Willey is back on!

Good pace again and he bowls it short angling into leg at 143 kph. Teja Nidamanuru looks to pull but gets hit on his gloves. The ball rolls towards backward square leg and a single is taken. He seems to be in some pain here with that blow on his hand.
Back of a length, on off. Teja Nidamanuru defends it onto the turf.
Shortens his length, on middle. Edwards works it to mid-wicket for a single.

SIX! What a way to get to his fifty! He is leader of the team today and is leading from the front with the bat as well. Carse goes full on off. Edwards decides to stand still and whacks it over long on for a maximum.
Carse goes full on middle. Teja Nidamanuru flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
Back of a length, on off. Teja Nidamanuru rides the bounce and blocks it out.
Brydon Carse (4-0-14-1) comes back to bowl.
Another dot to end the over! Back of a length, on off. Edwards defends it towards the off side and looks for a single initially but is sent back by his partner.
Beaten this time! Topley goes outside off and lands on a length again. Edwards tries to steer it towards third man but misses.
Again the batter uses that angles from Topley from 'round the wicket and nudges it to deep square leg for a single.
Angling into middle and slightly shorter in length. Edwards works it to square leg for a single.
On a length, on off. Edwards blocks it out.
Drifting on the pads. Teja Nidamanuru works it to fine leg for a single.
SIX! Netherlands need more shots like this! A fuller one on off. Edwards gets low and slog-sweeps it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
Again angling on the pads. Teja Nidamanuru clips it behind square on the leg side for a single.
Drifting on leg. Edwards sweeps it to deep backward square leg for a single.
This is pitched outside off. Teja Nidamanuru drives it towards covers for a single.
A flatter one on off. Teja Nidamanuru blocks it out.
On middle and fuller. Edwards works it to fine leg for a single.
On middle and bit fuller. Edwards pushes it to mid on for a single.
Short and wide, outside off. Edwards cuts it left of point. The fielder there dives and half-stops it. Couple of runs taken.
Serves a length delivery again, on off. Edwards manages only to defend it onto the turf.
Beats him this time! Lands on a length, around off. Edwards tries to guides it towards the off side but misses.
Fuller and angling into middle. Edwards works it towards mid-wicket.
Topley comes 'round the wicket and delivers on a length, on off. Edwards blocks it off the front foot.
Reece Topley is back on.

A beauty to end the over! Tosses it up, tighter line, around off. This one lands around middle and spins away. Teja Nidamanuru looks to block this but he misses and the ball zips past his outside edge.
Full again, flatter, around middle. Scott Edwards works it away to mid-wicket. He takes a single.
Bye! Shorter, quicker, outside off. Teja Nidamanuru misses his cut and Jos Buttler fails to grab it as well. Bye taken!
Full again, firing it on the pads. Scott Edwards sweeps it towards square leg. One run taken!
Full, around middle and leg. Teja Nidamanuru dances down the pitch and pushes it to long on for a single.
Slower through the air, full, around middle. Teja Nidamanuru knocks it on the right of the bowler. Liam Livingstone dives to his right and makes a good stop.
Tosses it up, full, around middle and off. Scott Edwards tries to sweep but he fails to get any bat on it.
Spinning in, around middle and leg. Scott Edwards misses his flick and gets hit on his pads.
Shorter now, around off. Teja Nidamanuru pushes it towards cover and takes a single. Smart batting by Teja Nidamanuru here!
SIX! Bang! This is some good intent shown by the batters now! Loopy ball, full, around middle. Teja Nidamanuru smokes it straight down the ground for a biggie.
Slightly shorter now, outside off. Scott Edwards taps it towards point and takes a single.
FOUR! Great use of the feet by Scott Edwards! Tosses this one up, outside off. Scott Edwards dances down the track and heaves it in the vacant deep mid-wicket region for a boundary.
Shorter, around middle and leg. Teja Nidamanuru whips it towards mid-wicket for a brace.
Slower through the air, full, around off. Scott Edwards reverse-sweeps this towards point and rotates the strike.
Shorter, flatter, around middle and leg. Teja Nidamanuru flicks it to square leg for a single.
Loopy ball now, around off. Teja Nidamanuru blocks it out.
Flatter, outside off, shorter ball. Teja Nidamanuru punches it to cover.
FOUR! Up and over! Slower through the air, full, spinning away. Teja Nidamanuru waits for it and lifts it over mid off for a boundary.
Shorter, around middle and off. Scott Edwards pushes it towards cover and he is denied a single there!
Flatter, outside off, tad quicker. Scott Edwards once again tries to sweep this from outside off but he misses it this time.
FOUR! Perfectly executed! Full, turning in around off. Scott Edwards sweeps it in the gap between deep square leg and deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Shorter ball, spinning in outside off. Teja Nidamanuru pushes it off the back foot through cover for a single.
Fuller, spinning in, around middle. Teja Nidamanuru presses forward and blocks it out.
Quicker, shorter, around off. Teja Nidamanuru steps down and tries to block this but he misses and gets hit on his thigh pad.
Loopy ball, full, around middle. Scott Edwards blocks it out.
Teja Nidamanuru is the next man in.

OUT! TAKEN! This is just what England needed! Liam Livingstone has broken this partnership. Bas de Leede departs after a good start. Quicker, leg-break, around off, tad fuller. Bas de Leede dances down the track and looks to clear the man at mid on. But the ball goes off the bottom and flies high. David Willey at mid on pouches it safely.
Commentary.Howout: c David Willey b Liam Livingstone

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller, around middle. Scott Edwards reverse-sweeps this towards short third man for a single.
Tad shorter, leg-break, around middle and off. Bas de Leede stays back and looks to block this but the ball goes off the inside edge towards square leg for a single.
Tosses this one up, slower, around off. Scott Edwards knocks it down to long off and rotates the strike.
Quicker, flatter, around off. Bas de Leede pushes it towards cover and takes a single.

DRINKS! After losing three wickets in quick succession, Bas de Leede and Scott Edwards have steadied the Netherlands ship. They have done some repair work and have put together 57 runs so far. England have been right on the money. They have caused a lot of trouble but will want to continue to take wickets.
Slower in the air from Ali. Bas de Leede uses his feet again and eases it down to long on for a single.
A fuller one on off. Scott Edwards pushes it to long on for a single.
On middle and turning in. Bas de Leede works it to mid-wicket for a single.
Ali goes full on middle. Bas de Leede sweeps it towards fine leg for a couple.
FOUR! Nice use of the feet! Tossed up on off. Bas de Leede gets to the pitch of the ball and flicks it aerially towards the deep mid-wicket region for a boundary.
A flatter one on off. Bas de Leede blocks it off the front foot.
This is on off and Scott Edwards goes for a reverse-sweep now. He hits that in the gap towards deep point for a couple.
On middle and turning into the batter. Edwards looks to sweep it but misses. He gets hit high on his pads.
It is a bit outside off and Bas de Leede pushes it square off the wicket on the off side for a single.
Pushed quicker on off. Bas de Leede with a gentle push towards the off side.
Goes fuller, around off. Bas de Leede drives but finds the fielder at covers.
A flatter delivery on off. Bas de Leede blocks it out.
Liam Livingstone comes to bowl.
Goes outside off and fuller. Edwards defends but gets a thick outside edge towards short third man.
A flatter one on middle. Bas de Leede nudges it to mid-wicket for another single.
Loopy delivery on off. Edwards looks to defend. He, however, gets an outside edge of his blade towards short third man and a single is taken.
Gives a bit of air, on off. Bas de Leede uses his feet and pushes it to long on for a single.
Bowls a bit quicker on off. Edwards works it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Nicely tossed up delivery on off. Edwards pushes it to mid on.
Moeen Ali comes into the attack.
A flatter and quicker one on off. Bas de Leede pushes it towards the off side.
WIDE! Bowls a googly but drifts down the leg side. Bas de Leede looks to work it towards the leg side but misses.
Angling on the pads again. Edwards works it left of short fine leg for a single.
A googly on middle and slightly short. Edwards defends it back to the bowler.
FOUR! This is much-better from Scott Edwards! Good intent. A tossed up delivery on off. Scott Edwards gets low and nails the slog-sweep towards deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Fuller again on off. Bas de Leede drives it to mid off for a single.
Slower in the air and tossed up on off. Bas de Leede blocks it off the front foot.
Goes a fraction full on middle. Edwards drives it to mid on.
Good pace again, this one is bowled at 144 clicks! A length delivery, around off. Scott Edwards only manages to push it towards the point fielder.
On a length, around off. Bas de Leede steers it towards third man for a single.
Beaten! Another skiddy delivery that is a tad shorter in length, around off. Bas de Leede looks to pull but misses.
On a length, on off. Bas de Leede blocks it out.
Lands on a length, on middle. Scott Edwards tries to work it towards the leg side but gets the inside edge onto his pads. The ball rolls towards the off side and a single is taken.
Beaten this time! Nicely tossed up this one, it lands around off and spins away. Bas de Leede prods forward and tries to defend this but he gets beaten on the outside edge.
Outside this time, fuller ball, loopy one. Bas de Leede drives and finds the fielder at cover.
Slower through the air again, around middle, full in length. Bas de Leede defends it out.
Full, around middle and leg. Bas de Leede presses forward and defends it out.
SIX! Bang! That has gone and cracked the commentator box's window! A loopy ball, full, around middle. Bas de Leede clears his front foot and tonks it over long on for a biggie!
Quicker, tosses it up, around middle and leg. Scott Edwards knocks it towards square leg for a single.
Fuller, straighter, on the stumps. Bas de Leede pushes it back to the bowler.
Shorter ball, around middle. Scott Edwards pulls it towards deep mid-wicket. Three taken!

NOT OUT! Leg bye! A fuller ball this time, tailing back in, around the leg pole. Bas de Leede misses his flick and gets hit on his pad. A huge shout there for LBW, but the umpire says no. England goes up for the review and Ball Tracking indicates that was sliding down leg. Yet another review lost. Bas de Leede also crosses ends and steals in a leg bye. This is good bowling from Brydon Carse. He s getting the ball to talk here!

DRS Time! England have taken a review for LBW against Bas de Leede here! The replays roll in and the UltraEdge shows no bat involved. Ball Tracking rolls and it shows that the ball is missing stumps. So the original decision stays and England lose another review.
Shorter ball, around off. Scott Edwards taps it towards cover for a single.
Leg bye! Another length delivery, nipping in a bit, on the pads. Bas de Leede this time misses his flick. The ball deflects off his pads and goes towards square leg for yet another leg bye.
Leg bye! A length ball, angling in, on the pads. Scott Edwards misses his flick and the ball rolls towards fine leg off his pads. A leg bye taken!
Flighted delivery, outside off, fuller ball. Bas de Leede pushes it towards point.
Beaten! Loopy ball, spinning away, outside off. Bas de Leede presses forward and tries to block this but he gets beaten on the outside edge.
Tad shorter, around the off pole. Scott Edwards pushes it past cover-point and takes a single.
Full, around off, slower through the air. Scott Edwards sweeps it toward deep square leg for a brace.

Tosses this one up, serves it down the leg side. Scott Edwards looks to flick but he misses. The ball might have just brushed off his pad there. An appeal for caught behind! But the umpire says no. Eoin Morgan opts for a review. UltraEdge shows a flat line as the ball passes through the bat. They check for LBW as well. Ball Tracking indicates that the impact was outside leg. Not out it is! England also lose a review here!

Overthrow! Very full, loopy ball, around off. Bas de Leede drives it towards mid off. Philip Salt there collects the ball and scores a direct hit at the non-striker's end. The ball rolls away and the batters sneak in a run here!
Pitched up again, on the pads. Bas de Leede flicks it past mid-wicket for three runs!
Outside off, on a length. Scott Edwards taps it towards point.
Full, around middle, at 146 clicks. Scott Edwards pushes it toward mid on.
Ohh! A beauty! Brydon Carse hits the deck hard, around off, shorter ball. at around 140 clicks. Scott Edwards hops and leaves it alone. The ball zips past his helmet!
Fuller now, around off. Bas de Leede looks to drive this but he gets an inside edge towards fine leg for a single.
Outside off, on a length. Bas de Leede leaves it alone.

Quick single! Loopy ball, around off. Bas de Leede drives it towards cover and scampers across to the other end. Jason Roy dives, collects the ball and throws it towards Jos Buttler. He grabs the ball, but he does not whip the bails off! Had he done that England would have got another wicket!
On middle, slower through the air. Bas de Leede blocks it out.
FOUR! Much-needed boundary for the Dutch! Very full, loopy ball, around off. Bas de Leede drives it past cover for a boundary.
Tosses it up again, around off. Bas de Leede drives it towards cover.
A fuller ball, around off. Scott Edwards sweeps it from outside off towards square leg for a single.

Successful review for Netherlands! A loopy ball, around middle, spinning away just a bit. Scott Edwards leans to defend but he misses and gets hit on his front pad. A huge shout for LBW, and the umpire raises his finger immediately. Scott Edwards is quick as well to review this one. No bat involved there, confirms UltraEdge. Ball Tracking indicates that was missing wickets! Scott Edwards survives!

Two runs to end an impressive first over from Carse! A full delivery on middle. Bas de Leede looks to clip it away but gets the inside edge that goes towards the backward square leg region for a couple.
On a length, on middle at 142 kph. Scott Edwards works it to fine leg for a single.
Well bowled! A very full pacy delivery on middle. Scott Edwards manages to work it towards the leg side.
Back of a length, on off. Scott Edwards looks to push it towards the off side but gets the inside edge onto his pads.
Scott Edwards walks out to bat at number 5.

OUT! LBW! Brydon Carse strikes in his second delivery and gets rid of Tom Cooper! This is a great start for the young man and Netherlands lose their third. Carse delivers it on a length and on middle. Cooper tries to work it towards the leg side but misses it completely. The ball hits his pads and there is a big appeal. The umpire raises his finger as it looks dead straight and Cooper also does not go for a review and walks back after a promising start.
Lands on a length, on middle. Cooper works it towards mid-wicket.
Brydon Carse comes into the attack.
A googly that pitches on middle. Bas de Leede looks to punch it off the back foot but is cramped for room and gets the inside edge onto his pads.
Tossed up and outside off. Cooper drives it to sweeper cover for a single.
A fuller delivery on middle. Bas de Leede works it to short fine leg and takes a single.
Bas de Leede comes to the crease.

OUT! CAUGHT! Ohh...gone! What a good catch from Dawid Malan! Both the openers are back in the hut now and Netherlands are in a spot of bother here. A fuller delivery and slower in the air too, on off. Max O'Dowd gets low and sweeps, he does that pretty well but it's a bit aerial. Dawid Malan at square leg moves to his left and dives full-stretch to take a fantastic catch. Netherlands need a partnership here!
Commentary.Howout: c Dawid Malan b Adil Rashid

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller, on off. Cooper drives it wide of long off for a single.
Starts with a flatter delivery on off. Cooper punches it to covers.
Time for Powerplay 2! Now, 4 fielders will be allowed to be placed outside the inner circle till the 33rd over. Also, it's time for some spin as Adil Rashid comes into the attack.
Topley bangs it short on off. Cooper pulls it behind square leg for a single.
Topley goes tad full and on off. Cooper drives it back to the bowler.
A good-length delivery, outside off. Cooper with a watchful leave.
A fuller delivery on off. Cooper drives it to mid off.
FOUR! Another quality shot from Tom Cooper! Back of a length, around off. Cooper picks the length quickly and goes back to punch it away through covers for a boundary.
Topley goes full but sprays it on the pads. Cooper flicks it to deep backward square leg for a couple.
Angling into the pads. Cooper works it to fine leg for a single.
FOUR! Nice shot! A shortish length again from Willey and provides a bit of width this time. Cooper rides the bounce and cuts it past point for a lovely boundary.
On a length, on off. Cooper blocks it out.
Lands on a length, around off. Max O'Dowd steers it towards third man for a single.
On a length, on middle. Cooper works it to fine leg for a single.

Tom Cooper gets off the mark with these two runs and becomes the fifth Netherlands batter to score more than 1000 runs. Back of a length, around off. Cooper punches it to covers and comes back for the second run.
A maiden from Reece Topley! On a length, on middle. Max O'Dowd gets a bit across and looks to work it fine towards the leg side but finds that fielder at short fine leg again.
Angling into the pads this time. Max O'Dowd clips it straight to the short fine leg fielder. Max O'Dowd will feel that he missed out there.
Again no width offered to the batter. On the shorter side, on off. Max O'Dowd rides the bounce and defends it towards the off side.
Back of a length, on middle. Max O'Dowd works it towards the leg side this time.
Pulls his length back this time, on middle and it nips back in a bit. Max O'Dowd looks to defend it but the ball beats him and hits him high on the pad.
Lands on a length, on off. Max O'Dowd blocks it solidly off the front foot.
On a length, around off, extra bounce there. Tom Cooper shuffles across and blocks it out. A terrific over from David Willey. A run and a wicket off it.
Around the off pole, a length ball. Tom Cooper taps it towards point.
Good-length delivery, around middle and leg. Tom Cooper tucks it towards square leg.
Beauty! A length ball, shaping away, outside off. Tom Cooper looks to have a poke at it but he misses.
Tom Cooper walks in at number 3.

OUT! TAKEN! David Willey draws first blood! An early breakthrough for England. This is a big wicket as Vikramjit Singh departs for a timid score. David Willey drops it short now, around off, at 131 clicks. Vikramjit Singh looks to pull this but he is a bit late on his shot, no power on that as well. The ball goes off the top edge and lobs up towards square leg. Brydon Carse there takes an easy catch. David Willey has now got him twice in this series!
Commentary.Howout: c Brydon Carse b David Willey

Commentary.Commentary: Outside off, tad fuller. Max O'Dowd pushes it past backward point for a single.
Tighter line this time from Reece Topley! Around off, length ball. Vikramjit Singh blocks it out.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Length ball, a little bit width on offer this time. Vikramjit Singh hangs back and slashes it past point for a boundary. First boundary for Vikramjit Singh and Netherlands!
Good-length delivery, around off, at 135 clicks. Vikramjit Singh lunges and defends it out.
Pitches it up now, around middle and leg. Vikramjit Singh flicks it in the gap between mid-wicket and mid of. Eoin Morgan chases the ball and keeps it to only two runs.
Length ball, around the off pole. Vikramjit Singh presses forward and blocks it out.
On a length, outside off. Max O'Dowd steers it down to third man and rotates the strike.
Good-length delivery again, around off. Vikramjit Singh pushes it towards cover. Good over from David Willey!
Length ball, width on offer this time. Vikramjit Singh cuts it towards point. Dawid Malan there does well to stop the ball.
David Willey drops it short now, around middle and off. Vikramjit Singh sways away from it.
Length ball, around off. Vikramjit Singh leans and blocks it out solidly.
Much straighter, on the pads, fuller ball. Vikramjit Singh clips it behind square on the leg side. Two taken!

Edged and just short! A length ball, around off. Vikramjit Singh looks to defend this but the ball goes off the outside edge just away from Moeen Ali at first slip. He dives and collects the ball on a bounce.
Outside off, fuller again. Vikramjit Singh leans to drive but the ball goes off the outside edge towards third man for a single. Tidy start from Reece Topley. Two runs off his first over.
Full again, darting it on the pads, at 135 clicks. Vikramjit Singh flicks it to the fielder at square leg.
Angling in on a fuller length, around middle. Vikramjit Singh knocks it to the fielder at mid on.
Outside off, length delivery, at 133 clicks. Max O'Dowd dabs it towards third man off the front foot for a single.
Another length ball, around off. Max O'Dowd blocks it out.
Reece Topley begins with a length delivery, swinging away, outside off. Max O'Dowd lets that go through to the keeper.
Reece Topley to share the new ball with David Willey.
Lovely shot! Max O'Dowd is up and running straightaway! A shorter ball, shaping away, outside off. Max O'Dowd stays back and pushes it past point. Three taken! 5 runs off the first over!
Good-length delivery, around off. Vikramjit Singh leans to defend this but the ball goes off the inside edge towards fine leg for a single. Vikramjit Singh gets off the mark!
Tad shorter again, around middle. Vikramjit Singh shows the full face of the bat and defends it out.
Back of a length, around middle. Vikramjit Singh defends it out towards the off side.
On middle, length delivery. Vikramjit Singh blocks it out.
Wide! David Willey errs in line now, serves it down the leg side. Vikramjit Singh leaves it alone. Wide called! Netherlands are underway!
David Willey begins with a length delivery, outside off. Not much movement there! Vikramjit Singh pushes it off the back foot towards point.

So, finally we are all ready for some action! The England players make their way out to the middle. Max O'Dowd and Vikramjit Singh are the openers for Netherlands. All happy faces in the crowd now and let's hope we don't have any rain intervention further. David Willey has a new cherry in his hand. Vikramjit Singh to take the strike. Here we go...

Dominic Cork is down for the pitch report. He says that the pitch is exactly the same as the last game and it is not going to change. Tells that there might be some spin later on but overall a very good batting surface. The only difference will be the change in the direction of the wind.

Eoin Morgan the captain of England says that they are happy to chase. Mentions that it is a special day for Jason Roy and Jos Buttler as their playing their 100th and 150th ODI game respectively, and they have been an integral part of the team, outstanding achievement. Adds that the message is that they should maintain their level of intensity, and they are never chasing figures or records. Informs that they have one change, Sam Curran misses out and Brydon Carse comes in.

Scott Edwards the skipper of Netherlands says that they will bat first. Tells that they are expecting the surface to slow up and it might help spinners later. Mentions that he is excited to get an opportunity to lead the side but is disappointed that Pieter Seelaar will miss this game. Adds that they have their plans ready for this game and are looking to execute them well. Informs that they have made three changes to their side.
England (Playing XI) - Jason Roy, Philip Salt, Dawid Malan, Eoin Morgan (C), Jos Buttler (WK), Liam Livingstone, Moeen Ali, David Willey, Brydon Carse (In for Sam Curran), Adil Rashid, Reece Topley.

Netherlands (Playing XI) - Vikramjit Singh, Max O'Dowd, Teja Nidamanuru (In for Musa Ahmad), Tom Cooper, Bas de Leede, Scott Edwards (C/WK), Logan van Beek, Tim Pringle (In for Pieter Seelaar), Shane Snater, Aryan Dutt, Vivian Kingma (In for Philippe Boissevain).
TOSS -  Netherlands have won the toss and they have elected to BAT first.

So, the news is that we have lost 9 overs per side. It will be 41 overs per side. Also, live visuals show Moeen Ali presenting Jason Roy with his 100th ODI cap while Eoin Morgan is presenting Jos Buttler with his 150th ODI cap.
